key_insight: Evi-Steer enables uncertainty-aware fine-tuning of biomedical vision-language models with minimal parameter updates.
clinical_relevance: This approach enhances the robustness of models in clinical settings, especially under low-data scenarios and domain shifts.
method: Utilizes a low-dimensional steering framework for parameter-efficient updates.
Estimates epistemic uncertainty to update model parameters conservatively.
Incorporates cross-modal confidence fusion based on Dempster-Shafer theory.
evidence_signal: Evi-Steer was evaluated on 15 biomedical imaging datasets across 8 organs and 8 imaging modalities.
watch_item: Caution is advised regarding the model's performance in highly uncertain scenarios where evidence might be too weak.
paper_title: Evi-Steer: Learning to Steer Biomedical Vision-Language Models through Efficient and Generalizable Evidential Tuning
